heroLead: A focus timer for your desktop. Two modes — Focus and Break, time you scrub right on the digits, a pixel scene instead of a dull dial, an always-on-top overlay, and pure-time tracking.

about.title: About the product
about.desc: The Pomodoro technique works when the timer helps instead of getting in the way. Memora Pomodoro lives above all windows as a thin overlay, counts only the time you actually work, and shows a weekly focus chart. No subscriptions, no cloud — everything is stored locally on your device.

features.title: Features
features.f1: Two modes, nothing extra: Focus and Break
features.f2: Pure time — the timer pauses itself when you step away
features.f3: Set the time by scrubbing the digits: hold minutes or seconds and drag
features.f4: A pixel scene under the timer: dodge-the-obstacles flight or an activity chart
features.f5: Always-on-top overlay, stopwatch with laps, weekly chart, tray and global hotkeys

howTo.title: How to Start
howTo.step1: Download the build for your operating system
howTo.step3: Scrub the digits to set your time and press start
howTo.step4: Track your focus on the weekly chart
